title: Clo User Story - Soho Fashion
description:
SOHO FASHION reduced their 30-day sample cycle to just 7 days with CLO and CLO-SET. With a mature 3D workflow, this leading textile exporter achieved:

* 80% faster development for complex styles
* Hundreds of fewer physical samples produced each season
* 50% faster feedback cycles, leading to new product launches within a single week

"We are building a cloud-based design hub that integrates our years of accumulated technical resources and industry experience to meet a wide range of personalized needs. Throughout this process, CLO helps us empower the entire lifecycle of every garment."

We can directly complete the production, sewing, simulation, dyeing, hardening, and plating in Clo3D. All-in-one digitalization allows us to compress the development cycle of complex styles by 80%. We have also built our own 3D resource library. We have accumulated tens of thousands of fabrics and thousands of digital samples. We can communicate with customers in real-time, receive feedback from customers in real-time, and quickly modify them to better meet customer needs. In particular, we have shortened the average feedback cycle in the confirmation of samples to half. This is not only an increase in efficiency, but also a value-adjustment of the global fashion industry chain. In the past, we needed three or four rounds of food samples to confirm the shape of the sample. Now, with the help of 3D technology, we can preview the production results of our own samples in advance. By adjusting the results, we have greatly increased the accuracy of our samples, and directly reduced the number of rounds of sample production. We will connect the sample to Clo3D, print the sample, and make the sample clothes. This multi-tasking production environment allows us to compress the production cycle of new products to one week. How can Clo3D improve the quality of our products? Soho Fashion is working with Clo3D to complete the digital vision of the fashion industry. On the one hand, 3D virtual plating technology makes production more environmentally friendly and intelligent. This way, we can quickly respond to customer needs, and we can communicate effectively with customers with a visualized solution. On the other hand, we are building a cloud design platform to integrate the technological resources and industry experience accumulated over the years, and strive to meet all kinds of individualized needs. In this process, Clo3D helps us to achieve a complete sound cycle for every piece of clothing. We are also able to learn more about the product from a unique experience. markdown_content: ## Overview: SOHO Fashion’s 3D Design Workflow and Digitalization Goals This section introduces Liya and explains why SOHO Fashion moved from traditional, time-intensive sampling to 3D technology (Clo3D) for faster, higher-quality fashion development. It covers the overall impact on efficiency, accuracy, and the digitalization of the design team’s process. SOHO Fashion’s design team has been operating for more than 6 years. In earlier years, designers needed to spend a lot of time on development and sampling. With the adoption of 3D technology, the team can add more high-end materials, colors, and patterns. By previewing top-of-the-line results before physical production, they can quickly confirm design appearance and style details, improving both design efficiency and design quality. The customer sample time has been reduced from the original 30 days. Instead of waiting for long physical iteration cycles, the team can produce hundreds of samples each quarter, enabling more time to focus on developing the product itself. This shift is described as a new possibility for digitalization within the design team, allowing faster confirmation and iteration across complex styles. --- ## Using Clo3D for Sample Confirmation and End-to-End Digital Production This section details how SOHO Fashion uses **Clo3D** to complete sample confirmation and digital production steps, including sewing, simulation, and material-related processes. It also explains how their “all-in-one” digital workflow compresses the development cycle. Liya, a designer in SOHO Fashion’s digitalization team, explains that the team currently supports dozens of brands across Europe, North America, and South America. They use **Clo3D** to complete confirmation of prior samples. In Clo3D, the team can directly complete multiple production-related tasks: - production and workflow confirmation - sewing - simulation - dyeing - hardening - plating They describe this as an “all-in-one digitalization” approach that compresses the development cycle of complex styles by **80%**. --- ## 3D Resource Library and Real-Time Customer Feedback Loop This section explains SOHO Fashion’s internal **3D resource library** and how it supports real-time communication, rapid modification, and faster feedback cycles. It includes the scale of their stored digital assets and a measurable reduction in feedback time. SOHO Fashion has built its own 3D resource library, with: - **tens of thousands of fabrics** - **thousands of digital samples** With these assets, the team can communicate with customers in real time, receive customer feedback in real time, and quickly modify designs to better meet customer needs. A key metric shared is that they shortened the average feedback cycle for sample confirmation to **half**. This improvement is framed not only as increased efficiency, but also as a value adjustment for the global fashion industry supply chain. --- ## Reducing Physical Sampling Rounds Through 3D Preview and Adjustment This section focuses on how 3D previewing in Clo3D reduces the number of physical sampling rounds needed to confirm fit and shape. It includes a specific comparison of how many rounds were required previously versus now. In the past, the team needed **three or four rounds** of physical samples to confirm the shape of a sample. With 3D technology, they can preview the production results of their own samples in advance. By adjusting the 3D results before physical production, the team increases the accuracy of samples and directly reduces the number of rounds of sample production. They describe a process that connects the sample to **Clo3D**, prints the sample, and makes the sample clothes. They highlight that this multi-tasking production environment compresses the production cycle for new products to **one week**. --- ## How Clo3D Improves Product Quality: Virtual Plating, Cloud Platform, and Feedback Closure This section explains Clo3D’s role in improving quality through environmentally friendlier, intelligent workflows (virtual plating) and through a cloud design platform that integrates accumulated industry knowledge. It also describes a “sound cycle” for each garment and learning from unique experience. SOHO Fashion states it is working with **Clo3D** to complete the digital vision for the fashion industry. Two main quality-improvement mechanisms are described: 1. **3D virtual plating technology** This makes production more environmentally friendly and more intelligent. It enables the team to: - quickly respond to customer needs - communicate effectively with customers using a visualized solution 2. **A cloud design platform** The team is building a cloud design platform to integrate technological resources and industry experience accumulated over the years. The goal is to meet individualized needs. During this process, Clo3D is said to help achieve a complete “sound cycle” for every piece of clothing, allowing the team to learn more about the product through unique experience. --- ## Future Directions: Innovation, Business Focus, Customer Experience, and Sustainability This section outlines SOHO Fashion’s future product and innovation direction in relation to Clo3D, emphasizing business environment focus, customer experience, and sustainability. It preserves the stated intent to build more sustainable solutions. SOHO Fashion describes working on an innovative design for the future of **Clo3D**. With this new product direction, they aim to: - focus more on the business environment - improve the customer experience They also state they are working on a new product that will be **more sustainable for customers**, aligning future development with sustainability goals.
